record.paper_title: A max-type recursive model: some properties and open questions
record.original_question: For a fixed integer m ≥ 2, let X_0 be a nonconstant Z_+-valued random variable and define X_{n+1} = max(X_n^{(1)} + ... + X_n^{(m)} - 1, 0), where X_n^{(1)}, ..., X_n^{(m)} are independent copies of X_n. Assume the criticality condition (m−1) E[X_0 m^{X_0}] = E[m^{X_0}] < ∞, possibly supplemented by additional integrability such as E[X_0^3 m^{X_0}] < ∞ if needed. Is it true that the boundary moment-generating quantity satisfies E[m^{X_n}] − 1 ~ 2 / ((m−1)n) as n → ∞?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an integer $m\geq 2$. Let $X_0$ be a non-constant random variable taking values in $\mathbb{Z}_+ = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$. Define recursively
$$X_{n+1} = \max\!\left(X_n^{(1)} + X_n^{(2)} + \cdots + X_n^{(m)} - 1,\; 0\right), \qquad n\geq 0,$$
where, for each $n$, the random variables $X_n^{(1)},\dots,X_n^{(m)}$ are independent copies of $X_n$ (all independence between generations is assumed). Suppose the critical condition
$$(m-1)\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[X_0\, m^{X_0}\right] \;=\; \mathbb{E}\!\left[m^{X_0}\right] \;<\; \infty$$
holds, possibly together with the additional integrability assumption $\mathbb{E}[X_0^{3} m^{X_0}] < \infty$. Prove or disprove that
$$\mathbb{E}\!\left[m^{X_n}\right] - 1 \;\sim\; \frac{2}{(m-1)\,n} \qquad \text{as } n\to\infty.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work (notably Chen–Dagard–Hu–Shi–Yao, Ann. Probab. 2021) proved the Derrida–Retaux conjecture about the essential-singularity exponent 1/2 for the free energy at the transition, and related papers on generalized/continuous-time Derrida–Retaux models established refined asymptotics in special cases. However, no source clearly confirms the exact equivalent $\mathbb{E}[m^{X_n}] - 1 \sim 2/((m-1)n)$ as conjectured for the general critical $\mathbb{Z}_+$-valued initial law; in a related generalized model the leading constant has appeared as $1/(m-1)$ rather than $2/(m-1)$. Therefore the precise status of this specific asymptotic appears unresolved from publicly available evidence.

status_evidence.title: The Derrida–Retaux conjecture on recursive models
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the free-energy essential singularity with exponent 1/2 at the transition, under suitable integrability.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the free-energy part of the Derrida–Retaux conjecture but does not state the precise asymptotic 2/((m-1)n) for E[m^{X_n}]-1.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic behavior of the generalized Derrida–Retaux recursive model
status_evidence.snippet: Critical-case corollary gives E(m^{Y_n}) = 1 + 1/((m-1)n) + lower-order terms for the generalized model.
status_evidence.claim: In a generalized variant the leading constant appears as 1/(m-1), not 2/(m-1), so this does not directly confirm the conjecture for the original max-type recursion.

status_evidence.title: A Max-Type Recursive Model: Some Properties and Open Questions
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates the conjecture E(m^{X_n}) - 1 ~ 2/((m-1)n) at criticality as an open question.
status_evidence.claim: The asymptotic with constant 2/(m-1) is stated as a conjecture.
